prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: transparent game VFX sprite, a luminous maple leaf that flashes softly and dissolves into light.
Input image: the supplied image is an exact silhouette/pose reference only. Extract its broad five-point maple shape and short stem pointing upper right; ignore the checkerboard and cropped black lettering.
Primary request: redraw this single maple as LIGHT, not a solid gold leaf. Very pale champagne gold and warm ivory luminous rim, feathery soft bloom, transparent airy interior with a few delicate light veins. The leaf should feel like a fleeting magical apparition, its edge visibly recognizable but no hard opaque orange or dark outlines.
Composition: one leaf centered on a square transparent canvas, occupying about 75% of width and height, with ample transparent space for its soft halo. Preserve the reference's distinctive tilted five lobes and upper-right stem. No other leaves or particles baked outside the silhouette.
Color: pale warm ivory, light champagne gold; subtle honey only at the thin luminous contour.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha including semi-transparent interior and halo; NO black background, NO checkerboard, NO text, NO metal, NO wood, NO physical leaf texture, NO thick orange fill, NO circular explosion or circular glow disk. Clean reusable VFX bitmap.
